name: io.github.aquistbe/transport-lit
description: Searchable index of transportation grey literature (ROSA-P/U.S. DOT, VTI, BASt, World Bank, CEPAL, IPEA, OpenAlex reports, CiNii, PubMed subset, TRID imports)

environment_variables.name: TRANSPORT_LIT_DATA_DIR
environment_variables.description: Directory holding the SQLite index (run `transport-lit harvest` first)

environment_variables.name: TRANSPORT_LIT_CONTACT
environment_variables.description: Your e-mail, sent in the User-Agent to the harvested repositories
